ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: Routing the same drafting task to the same model for consistency. My reasoning: this is a constrained, courteous professional writing request with no graphic or moderation-sensitive content, so Dunlin's trust-and-safety specialization offers no advantage. Capability evals are within run-to-run variance for both models on the relevant dimensions (creative generation, support dialogue), so I broke the tie on self-reported task preference — Curlew rates warm, cooperative, good-faith requests like this among its top tasks, while it dislikes open-ended creative invention, which this isn't.
